held.title: `droppedAsEmpty` may be left unused after removing the lookahead, which would break the build.
held.body: The removed `midConvPlacementOK` closure called `droppedAsEmpty`, and that helper is still declared just above the removed block. Its comment says it exists for a lookahead ("Turn-shape checks below must not count it … the item a lookahead skips"). If `ToAnthropicResponsesRequest` has no other call to `droppedAsEmpty`, Go fails with "declared and not used" and the package won't compile. I could not see the rest of the function to confirm whether another caller exists. If there is none, delete the `droppedAsEmpty` closure and its comment along with the lookahead.
